page.overview:
Who is Chanya Diogo?

Chanya Diogois is the proprieter of the trade harbor at Jurassic World in Jurassic World: The Game.

Chanya Diogo provides trades for players at the Trade Harbor located near the Biosphere. She provides a random selection of trades and gives them one Custom Trade (3 for VIPs) per day. Items that can be traded are coins, food supplies, DNA, cash, dinosaurs, aquatic and cenozoic creatures, boosters, buildings, decorations, and loyalty points. VIP players on the other hand receives exclusive trades, usually in the form of VIP buildings, decorations, and creatures.

"I've looked up and down this island to get you the best deal."

"Look, I'm running late. This deal here. Take it or leave it."
